SS Rajamouli's 'Varanasi' film nears completion with 80 shooting days remaining

Filmmaker SS Rajamouli's upcoming project, tentatively titled 'Varanasi' and starring Mahesh Babu, has approximately 80 days of shooting left. The film is still on track for its planned April 2027 release. The project has been in production for some time, with this update indicating progress towards its completion.
